threads.body: This hides every non-required coverage change whenever any attribute changed, including denominator changes the attribute list cannot explain. For example, an unrelated attribute replacement combined with `recommended` coverage moving from 1/1 to 1/2 would omit the registry-driven denominator change. Keep denominator changes visible while suppressing only numerator-only noise.
